question: A light bulb emits monochromatic light of wavelength $\lambda$ uniformly in all directions with power $P$. A small black body of mass $m$ and specific heat capacity $s$ is placed at a distance $d$ from the bulb. Assuming the body absorbs all radiation falling on its cross-sectional area $A$ and loses no heat to the surroundings, what is the rate of rise of its temperature ($dT/dt$)?
